title: Principal, PGT and Non-Teaching Staff Recruitment
organization: KGBV Maharajganj (Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Maharajganj)
application_fee: Rs 56-56 postal stamp on self-addressed envelope
age_limit: Principal: 30 to 45 years as of 01-04-2026 (Max 60 years for retired); Other posts: 25 to 45 years as of 01-04-2026
summary: Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Maharajganj has advertised contractual vacancies for various teaching and non-teaching positions in upgraded Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas. Eligible female candidates can apply through registered or speed post by 10 December 2026 up to 05:00 PM.
eligibility_bullets: Only female candidates are eligible to apply.
Must possess the required educational qualification and professional training as specified for the post.
Age must be within the specified limits as of 01-04-2026.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format and notification from the official website https://maharajganj.nic.in.
Fill out the application form with required details and attach self-attested copies of educational, professional, and category certificates.
Enclose an additional self-addressed envelope affixed with a postal stamp of Rs 56-56.
Send the completed application by registered or speed post to the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Maharajganj, Pincode 273303 so as to reach by 10-12-2026 up to 05:00 PM.
